other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Mention of hospital co-generation (CHP) systems using diesel engines and gas turbines as a driver of high energy consumption
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Factors like air conditioning, hot water
supply, and operation of co-generation systems comprised of
diesel engines and gas turbines contribute to high consumption
profiles [2].

one_line: The paper applies regression / feature-selection machine learning to predict electricity consumption in hospitals (commercial healthcare buildings), explicitly a non-industrial, non-continuous context; cogeneration is mentioned only as a hospital energy factor.
